{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "afc52ab91691739eb8f946a0dc4b9573cf709b7c2cad22a019f98be15a323af6",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"LocalDef001","meaning":"For a real normed vector space E, this predicate says left < right, field is interval integrable between those endpoints, and average equals LocalDef004 field left right.","effect_on_target":"Each of four conjuncts certifies positive interval length, integrability, and equality to the explicitly supplied normalized integral; it does not assert attainment at a point.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"LocalDef002","meaning":"The integral of field against μ restricted to region, multiplied by the reciprocal of the real conversion of μ(region).","effect_on_target":"Two conclusions identify normalized interval integrals with this normalized restricted-measure integral, for the old density and left boundary flux only.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"LocalDef003","meaning":"For a real module with an additive commutative group, maps timeStep, cellVolume, oldAverage and netOutwardFlux to oldAverage − (timeStep/cellVolume) • netOutwardFlux.","effect_on_target":"Defines the updated vector using timeStep = t−s, cellVolume = b−a, and right numerical flux minus left numerical flux.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"LocalDef004","meaning":"The oriented interval integral of field from left to right, multiplied by (right−left)⁻¹.","effect_on_target":"Defines both spatial density averages and both temporal boundary-flux averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"Algebra.id","meaning":"A commutative semiring is an algebra over itself with identity algebra map and scalar action given by multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Real scalars act on individual real coordinates by real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"Algebra.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts the scalar action stored in an algebra structure.","effect_on_target":"Selects the real multiplication action underlying explicit vector scalar multiplications.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"And","meaning":"Logical conjunction of two propositions.","effect_on_target":"All ten top-level conclusions hold simultaneously; the four average predicates themselves contain conjunctions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"CommSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts the semiring structure from a commutative semiring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real semiring operations for the algebra action without additional hypotheses.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"DivInvMonoid.toDiv","meaning":"Extracts the division operation from a division-and-inversion monoid structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies division in the real ratio (t−s)/(b−a).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"Eq","meaning":"Equality of two elements of the same type.","effect_on_target":"Vector equalities are exact equalities of functions, hence equality at every coordinate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"Fin","meaning":"The finite index type of natural numbers smaller than its natural-number parameter.","effect_on_target":"Vectors have coordinates indexed by 0 through m−1; m > 0 excludes the empty coordinate type.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"Fin.fintype","meaning":"Enumerates Fin n using List.finRange n, with no repetitions and complete coverage.","effect_on_target":"Provides finiteness for the product norm and vector-space constructions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"Function.hasSMul","meaning":"Lifts a scalar action on the codomain to the Pi scalar action on functions.","effect_on_target":"Vector scalar multiplication acts coordinatewise.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"HAdd.hAdd","meaning":"Extracts the addition operation from an HAdd instance.","effect_on_target":"Uses real addition for bounds and coordinatewise addition for vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"HDiv.hDiv","meaning":"Extracts the division operation from an HDiv instance.","effect_on_target":"Forms the real time-to-length ratio.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"HMul.hMul","meaning":"Extracts the multiplication operation from an HMul instance.","effect_on_target":"Multiplies the real ratio by the sum of the two real flux-error bounds.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"HSMul.hSMul","meaning":"Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from an HSMul instance.","effect_on_target":"Scales vector integrals, differences and numerical fluxes by real numbers.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"HSub.hSub","meaning":"Extracts the subtraction operation from an HSub instance.","effect_on_target":"Forms real interval lengths and coordinatewise vector differences with the displayed signs.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace","meaning":"Extracts the normed-space structure from an inner-product-space structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real-coordinate normed-space structure used in vector integration; no vector inner product appears in the conclusion.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"IntervalIntegrable","meaning":"Integrability on both (a,b] and (b,a] against the specified measure.","effect_on_target":"Because endpoints are strictly increasing, the four assumptions require integrability on the respective forward half-open intervals; the reverse intervals are empty.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"LE.le","meaning":"Extracts a non-strict order relation.","effect_on_target":"All bound hypotheses and the final estimate use real ≤.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"LT.lt","meaning":"Extracts a strict order relation.","effect_on_target":"Expresses m > 0, a < b and s < t.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace","meaning":"Extracts the measurable-space structure from a measure space.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the measurable structure for the real-domain restricted integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume","meaning":"Extracts the distinguished measure of a measure-space structure.","effect_on_target":"Every target integral uses the distinguished measure of Real.measureSpace, denoted μ below.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"Nat","meaning":"The type of natural numbers, including zero.","effect_on_target":"The vector dimension is a natural number restricted by 0 < m.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative monoid from the given semiring-like structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real additive structure needed by the function module.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity while retaining the seminormed ring structure.","effect_on_target":"Participates in obtaining the coordinate additive seminormed structure without altering operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains the norm, additive commutative group and pseudometric of a seminormed ring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the coordinate additive analytic structure for the product normed space.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Extracts the weaker semiring structure without requiring multiplication associativity in its interface.","effect_on_target":"Carries the existing real addition through the module instance construction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"Norm.norm","meaning":"Extracts the real-valued norm function from a Norm instance.","effect_on_target":"The four error magnitudes use the particular norm selected through Pi.normedRing.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup","meaning":"Retains norm, additive group and metric while forgetting additive commutativity in the interface.","effect_on_target":"Supplies coordinate normed groups for the product integrability structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Builds an extended-norm additive monoid from the existing normed additive group and its continuous extended norm.","effect_on_target":"Provides the extended norm used by the interval-integrability assumptions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"NormedCommRing.toNormedRing","meaning":"Extracts the normed ring from a normed commutative ring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real coordinate normed rings for the vector norm in the estimate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains norm, ring and pseudometric while weakening the metric interface.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the coordinate analytic operations used in the product normed space.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"NormedRing.toNorm","meaning":"Extracts the norm field of a normed ring.","effect_on_target":"Selects the vector norm from Pi.normedRing for every error bound.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"NormedSpace.toModule","meaning":"Extracts the underlying module of a normed space.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real scalar module used to define the numerical update.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"OfNat.ofNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural-number literal using its supplied OfNat instance.","effect_on_target":"Interprets the zero in 0 < m as natural-number zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"Pi.Function.module","meaning":"Uses the Pi module to make functions into a module through their codomain module.","effect_on_target":"The update acts on real coordinate vectors using coordinatewise linear operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"Pi.addCommGroup","meaning":"Builds the additive commutative group of functions from the coordinate groups.","effect_on_target":"Provides the vector additive group for the update definition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"Pi.instAdd","meaning":"Defines (f+g)(i) = f(i)+g(i).","effect_on_target":"All vector additions are coordinatewise.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"Pi.instSub","meaning":"Defines (f−g)(i) = f(i)−g(i).","effect_on_target":"All vector errors and flux differences are coordinatewise, preserving left/right order.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"Pi.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Builds a finite-function normed additive commutative group using the norm and pseudometric inherited from Pi.seminormedAddGroup.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the analytic vector structure for all integrals and averages. The inherited norm's coordinate formula is not expanded in the packet.","status":"unclear"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"Pi.normedAddGroup","meaning":"Builds a finite-function normed additive group using Pi.seminormedAddGroup's norm and pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the product extended-norm structure for integrability; its underlying norm formula is not exposed.","status":"unclear"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"Pi.normedRing","meaning":"Builds a finite-function normed ring with norm inherited from Pi.seminormedRing and metric separation supplied by the product normed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the norm in the final estimate, but the packet does not expand Pi.seminormedRing.toNorm enough to verify an explicit maximum-coordinate formula.","status":"unclear"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"Pi.normedSpace","meaning":"Equips finite dependent functions with the Pi module and its norm-compatible scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Makes the vector space a real normed space suitable for integration and scalar normalization.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"Pi.topologicalSpace","meaning":"The product topology, constructed from the topologies induced by all coordinate evaluation maps.","effect_on_target":"Integrability of vector-valued functions uses the finite product topology on real coordinates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace","meaning":"Extracts the uniform-space structure contained in a pseudometric space.","effect_on_target":"Connects the real distance structure to the topology used in vector integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal","meaning":"Builds a real inner-product-space structure on an RCLike field, using its normed algebra and the indicated real inner product.","effect_on_target":"At Real, supplies the coordinate real normed-space structure; no independent inner-product hypothesis is imposed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"Real","meaning":"The real-number type.","effect_on_target":"Coordinates, domain variables, endpoints, scalar ratios and bounds are real numbers.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"Real.instAdd","meaning":"Supplies Real.add as real addition.","effect_on_target":"Adds scalar bounds and, through Pi addition, vector coordinates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"Real.instAddCommGroup","meaning":"The supplied additive commutative group instance on the reals.","effect_on_target":"Provides coordinate additive group laws for the numerical update.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"Real.instCommSemiring","meaning":"The supplied commutative semiring instance on the reals.","effect_on_target":"Supports the identity real algebra and its multiplication scalar action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"Real.instDivInvMonoid","meaning":"Real multiplication and inversion with division defined as multiplication by an inverse.","effect_on_target":"The update ratio is (t−s) multiplied by the inverse of b−a.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"Real.instLE","meaning":"Supplies the real non-strict order.","effect_on_target":"Interprets all numerical upper bounds.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"Real.instLT","meaning":"Supplies the real strict order.","effect_on_target":"Requires positive spatial and temporal interval lengths.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"Real.instMul","meaning":"Supplies real multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Forms the product of the time-to-length ratio and total flux-error bound.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"Real.instPreorder","meaning":"The supplied preorder on the reals.","effect_on_target":"Determines membership in the half-open intervals used by normalized restricted integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"Real.instRCLike","meaning":"Treats the reals as an RCLike field with real part the identity, imaginary part zero, and the supplied normed field and completeness structures.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real-coordinate analytic structures; the target does not introduce complex-valued coordinates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"Real.instRing","meaning":"The supplied ring structure on the reals.","effect_on_target":"Provides additive and multiplicative operations needed by the coordinate module.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"Real.instSub","meaning":"Defines a−b as a plus the negation of b.","effect_on_target":"Determines interval differences and coordinate error signs.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"Real.measureSpace","meaning":"A measure-space instance on Real, whose body is only inferInstance in the packet.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the single measure μ used throughout. The packet does not expose its construction or normalization sufficiently to verify directly that μ is Lebesgue measure.","status":"unclear"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"Real.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Combines Real.norm, the real additive commutative group and Real.metricSpace.","effect_on_target":"Provides coordinate norms and metrics for vector integration and error measurement.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"Real.normedCommRing","meaning":"Combines the real normed additive group with real commutative ring operations and norm compatibility.","effect_on_target":"Supplies coordinate normed rings for the particular product norm in the bound.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"Real.normedField","meaning":"Combines the real normed additive group and field, including norm multiplicativity and inverse zero equal to zero.","effect_on_target":"Supports scalar normed spaces and totalized real inversion; positive interval lengths prevent zero denominators here.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"Real.pseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"Uses the real distance d(x,y) = |x−y|.","effect_on_target":"The coordinate topology is the usual real metric topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"Real.semiring","meaning":"The supplied semiring instance on the reals.","effect_on_target":"Provides the scalar semiring for the vector module.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"Ring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts a semiring from a ring.","effect_on_target":"Carries real arithmetic into the additive-monoid construction for the function module.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains norm, additive operations, multiplication and pseudometric while dropping the multiplicative-unit interface.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real coordinate seminormed additive structure used by normed spaces.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring","meaning":"Extracts a nonunital semiring structure from a semiring.","effect_on_target":"Provides an intermediate projection to the real additive commutative monoid.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"Set.Ioc","meaning":"The set of x such that a < x and x ≤ b.","effect_on_target":"All restricted averaging regions are left-open, right-closed intervals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace","meaning":"Extracts the topology stored in a uniform space.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real coordinate topology used to construct the product topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"instHAdd","meaning":"Uses ordinary addition as homogeneous HAdd.","effect_on_target":"Resolves displayed additions to their real or coordinatewise vector operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"instHDiv","meaning":"Uses ordinary division as homogeneous HDiv.","effect_on_target":"Resolves the update ratio to real division.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"instHMul","meaning":"Uses ordinary multiplication as homogeneous HMul.","effect_on_target":"Resolves multiplication in the scalar upper bound.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"instHSMul","meaning":"Uses an SMul operation as HSMul with unchanged target type.","effect_on_target":"Resolves real scaling of vectors in the averages, update and error identity.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"instHSub","meaning":"Uses ordinary subtraction as homogeneous HSub.","effect_on_target":"Resolves real and vector differences to their supplied subtraction operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"instLTNat","meaning":"Uses Nat.lt as the strict order on natural numbers.","effect_on_target":"The hypothesis and first conclusion both assert positive dimension.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"instOfNatNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural literal n as n itself.","effect_on_target":"The dimension comparison uses literal natural zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"intervalIntegral","meaning":"The restricted integral over (a,b] minus the restricted integral over (b,a].","effect_on_target":"Fixes the orientation of every physical-balance integral and normalized interval average; increasing endpoints leave the forward integral.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"AddCommGroup","meaning":"An additive group with commutative addition.","effect_on_target":"The generic update requires subtraction and a real module, instantiated by coordinate vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Retains addition, zero and commutativity from an additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the additive monoid required by the update's module structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddGroup","meaning":"Extracts the additive group from an additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Provides the subtraction-bearing additive structure in the generic update.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid","meaning":"Extracts addition, negation and compatible subtraction from an additive group.","effect_on_target":"Connects the update's additive group to its subtraction operation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass","meaning":"Retains addition and its two-sided zero identity.","effect_on_target":"Provides zero-related structure in the module scalar-action projection chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"AddZero.toZero","meaning":"Extracts the zero element.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the vector zero used by the scalar-action structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"AddZeroClass.toAddZero","meaning":"Retains the addition and zero operations.","effect_on_target":"Provides an intermediate projection needed for the generic scalar action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"DFunLike.coe","meaning":"Extracts the function represented by a function-like object.","effect_on_target":"Allows evaluating the measure on an averaging region.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D088","name":"DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul","meaning":"Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.","effect_on_target":"Carries the module's scalar action into the generic update formula.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D089","name":"DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass","meaning":"Extracts the zero-preserving scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Provides another projection of the same scalar multiplication used in the update.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D090","name":"ENNReal","meaning":"Nonnegative real numbers with an additional top element representing infinity.","effect_on_target":"Measure values must be converted to real numbers before the normalization in LocalDef002.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D091","name":"ENNReal.toReal","meaning":"Converts an extended nonnegative real by first applying toNNReal and then converting that nonnegative real to Real.","effect_on_target":"Determines the scalar denominator of region averages; the behavior of the unexpanded toNNReal at infinity is not specified by the displayed body.","status":"unclear"},
    {"id":"D092","name":"ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Retains the extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies weaker analytic structure underlying generic integral constructions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D093","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative monoid from an extended-seminormed one.","effect_on_target":"Provides the underlying additive operations used by integral-related structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D094","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Retains the extended-seminormed additive monoid while forgetting commutativity in the interface.","effect_on_target":"Connects the normed vector structure to weaker integral-related structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D095","name":"ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive monoid from an extended-seminormed additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies addition and zero beneath the generic integration infrastructure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D096","name":"Inv.inv","meaning":"Extracts the inverse operation.","effect_on_target":"Normalizes integrals by reciprocals of interval lengths or converted region measures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D097","name":"MeasurableSpace","meaning":"A measurable-space structure specifying a sigma-algebra of measurable sets.","effect_on_target":"Supports the measure and restricted integrals used by the region-average definition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D098","name":"MeasureTheory.Measure","meaning":"A measure on a type equipped with a measurable-space structure.","effect_on_target":"The averaging definition takes such a measure; the target specializes it to μ on Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D099","name":"MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike","meaning":"Evaluates a measure on sets through its underlying outer-measure function, producing extended nonnegative reals.","effect_on_target":"Makes μ((a,b]) and μ((s,t]) the normalization inputs for the two region averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D100","name":"MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict","meaning":"Applies the measure-restriction linear map associated with a set to a measure.","effect_on_target":"Selects integration over the half-open averaging regions; the underlying restriction map is not expanded further.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D101","name":"MeasureTheory.integral","meaning":"A vector-valued integration operation from a measure and function to an element of a real normed additive commutative group; its supplied body is an opaque wrapped projection.","effect_on_target":"All averages and the balance assumption depend on this operation. Its Bochner construction and behavior outside the integrable domain cannot be independently recovered from the displayed body.","status":"unclear"},
    {"id":"D102","name":"Module","meaning":"An additive commutative monoid with a scalar action satisfying the module laws over a semiring.","effect_on_target":"For real scalars and an additive group, provides the vector-space operations needed by the numerical update.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D103","name":"Module.toDistribMulAction","meaning":"Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the same real scalar multiplication used by LocalDef003.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D104","name":"NormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"An additive commutative group with a norm and compatible metric.","effect_on_target":"Provides the analytic codomain structure required by interval and region averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D105","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Combines the normed group's extended norm with commutative addition and norm separation.","effect_on_target":"Supplies extended-norm structure beneath generic integrals without adding target assumptions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D106","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains the norm, additive commutative group and pseudometric from a normed group.","effect_on_target":"Provides the weaker additive structure required by generic normed-space instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D107","name":"NormedSpace","meaning":"A module over a normed field with scalar multiplication compatible with the norms.","effect_on_target":"Makes vector-valued integration and real scalar normalization available.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D108","name":"Real.instInv","meaning":"Supplies the real inverse operation through Real.inv'.","effect_on_target":"Forms reciprocals in both averaging definitions and real division; the target's interval lengths are nonzero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D109","name":"Real.instMonoid","meaning":"The supplied multiplicative monoid on the reals.","effect_on_target":"Supports real inversion-and-division structure without further assumptions on the data.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D110","name":"SMulZeroClass.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts scalar multiplication from a zero-preserving scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Exposes the module scalar multiplication in the update definition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D111","name":"SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"Extracts the pseudometric structure of a seminormed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Provides the topology-related structure supporting vector integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D112","name":"Set","meaning":"A set of elements of α is a predicate α → Prop.","effect_on_target":"The averaging regions are predicates specifying half-open intervals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D113","name":"SubNegMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive monoid from the structure containing subtraction and negation.","effect_on_target":"Supplies addition and zero beneath the generic update's module requirements.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D114","name":"SubNegMonoid.toSub","meaning":"Extracts the subtraction operation from a subtraction-and-negation monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies subtraction in LocalDef003 from its additive group structure.","status":"understood"}
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every natural number m with 0 < m, let V be the real coordinate-vector space Fin m → Real, with coordinates indexed by i = 0,...,m−1 and the supplied finite-product analytic structures.",
      "For every pair of types Cell and Face, in arbitrary universes, every function q : Real → Real → V, and every function flux : V → V.",
      "For every numericalOld : Cell → V and rule : (Cell → V) → Face → V. Thus rule takes the entire old numerical field and a face label.",
      "For every cell : Cell and leftFace, rightFace : Face.",
      "For every a, b, s, t : Real satisfying a < b and s < t.",
      "Inside the final conjunct, for every oldBound, leftBound, rightBound : Real, subject to the three stated norm upper bounds. There are no existentially quantified witnesses."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "The dimension m is positive.",
      "The spatial endpoints satisfy a < b and the temporal endpoints satisfy s < t.",
      "The functions x ↦ q(x,s) and x ↦ q(x,t) are interval integrable from a to b with respect to μ, the volume measure extracted from Real.measureSpace.",
      "The functions τ ↦ flux(q(a,τ)) and τ ↦ flux(q(b,τ)) are interval integrable from s to t with respect to μ.",
      "The vector balance identity holds: ∫_a^b q(x,t) dμ(x) − ∫_a^b q(x,s) dμ(x) = ∫_s^t [flux(q(a,τ)) − flux(q(b,τ))] dμ(τ)."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "The following ten assertions hold jointly. First, 0 < m.",
      "Second, a < b, x ↦ q(x,s) is interval integrable from a to b, and Q_s = (b−a)⁻¹ • ∫_a^b q(x,s) dμ(x).",
      "Third, a < b, x ↦ q(x,t) is interval integrable from a to b, and Q_t = (b−a)⁻¹ • ∫_a^b q(x,t) dμ(x).",
      "Fourth, s < t, τ ↦ flux(q(a,τ)) is interval integrable from s to t, and F_L = (t−s)⁻¹ • ∫_s^t flux(q(a,τ)) dμ(τ).",
      "Fifth, s < t, τ ↦ flux(q(b,τ)) is interval integrable from s to t, and F_R = (t−s)⁻¹ • ∫_s^t flux(q(b,τ)) dμ(τ).",
      "Sixth, Q_s = [toReal(μ((a,b]))]⁻¹ • ∫ q(x,s) d(μ restricted to (a,b])(x).",
      "Seventh, F_L = [toReal(μ((s,t]))]⁻¹ • ∫ flux(q(a,τ)) d(μ restricted to (s,t])(τ).",
      "Eighth, the explicitly defined update U_plus equals U − λ • (G_R−G_L).",
      "Ninth, Δx • (U_plus−Q_t) = Δx • (U−Q_s) + Δt • [(G_L−F_L)−(G_R−F_R)].",
      "Tenth, for all real oldBound, leftBound and rightBound, if ‖U−Q_s‖ ≤ oldBound, ‖G_L−F_L‖ ≤ leftBound and ‖G_R−F_R‖ ≤ rightBound, then ‖U_plus−Q_t‖ ≤ oldBound + λ(leftBound+rightBound)."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "μ denotes the measure Real.measureSpace.volume. All integral notation in this translation uses the supplied vector-valued integral operation.",
